reason: The plugin is primarily a user-facing interface customization plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, centered on themes and layout adjustments such as wallpaper, panel transparency, and message/input/scroll behavior. It also adds UI-side utilities via plugin APIs (archived session actions and file mentions), which is secondary to its main skinting goal, so it is conservatively classified under themes-layout with moderate local filesystem, network, and session-management impact.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的界面皮肤插件，用于自定义背景、面板透明度和布局交互，并额外提供归档会话与 @ 文件提及等前端增强入口。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness Web GUI skin and layout enhancement that customizes wallpaper, panel transparency, and interface behavior, with added front-end archive and @-mention utilities for files and sessions.

capabilities: session archive management via plugin APIs

reasons.code: README describes full UI skin behavior including full-screen wallpaper, panel transparency, and layout/scroll interaction customization for the DSH web GUI.
README documents plugin API routes for archived-session operations including rename, unarchive, and delete, plus mention-file retrieval endpoints.
README specifies browser File System Access API usage with IndexedDB-persisted file handles for local wallpaper images, with fallback to URL/inbuilt wallpaper.

capabilities: session archive management via plugin APIs
